audit_scope: source audit of generator timing, channel order, coordinate conventions and depth type; generated episode end-to-end checks remain separate
timestamp_conclusion: Post-step capture at step*dt is correct: step copies next states before return; due-frame observe renders current state. Do not apply an extra -0.005s shift.
rgb_depth_pair: Same rendering capture; one camera index 0; read depth after frames() resolves pending render.
imu: observe_imu first six channels are ax,ay,az,gx,gy,gz in body axes; final two channels are frame cadence diagnostics and excluded.
ground_truth: body pose in simulation world, not preconverted camera pose; Episode applies T_body_camera and first-camera normalization.
depth: camera-z metres, not ray range; generic renderer projects ray-hit distance onto camera-plane normal.
spatial_approximation: Depth sidecar nearest pixel (5,15,...) is +0.5 source pixel / +0.05 low-resolution pixel from INTER_AREA RGB centres; known documented approximation.
recommended_readback_check: Episode.check_consistency() verifies all IMU windows, quaternion norm, transforms, frame timing and GT coverage.
